reason: The README clearly describes an agent skill for retrieving K12 questions from an online question bank and creating practice, quizzes, tests, and paper-building requirements with answers and explanations.

summaries.zh: 面向中小学教育场景检索题库题目，并生成练习、测验、试卷要求及答案解析。
summaries.en: Retrieves K12 questions and creates practice exercises, quizzes, paper-building requirements, answer checks, and explanations.

capabilities: Searches and retrieves K12 questions from an online question-bank service
Filters questions by subject, grade, textbook, chapter, knowledge point, type, difficulty, and year
Generates practice exercises, quizzes, tests, and structured paper-building requirements
Provides answer checking, standard answers, and explanations for retrieved questions
